messages.purpose: Calm no-blame recovery with a fresh one-time link (next morning)
messages.text: Namaste Rajesh sir 🙂 Kal raat Rs. 5,400 ka payment bank OTP time-out ki wajah se complete nahi ho paya, aapki koi galti nahi. Yeh naya one-time link hai: [PAYMENT_LINK]. UPI ya card, jo aapko aasaan lage. Kabir ne PEEL se 60 second bina 'umm' ke bola tha, hum usi flow ko aage badhayenge.
approver_checklist: Link is a one-time link, not a mandate

messages.purpose: Offer help only if still unpaid
messages.text: Rajesh sir, agar payment link mein ab bhi dikkat aa rahi ho, toh main 5 minute ki call par help kar sakti hoon, ya aap card ya net banking se try kar sakte hain. Jo aapko comfortable ho.
Rajesh sir, Kabir ke exams 15 tarikh se shuru ho rahe hain. Agar aap exams ke baad shuru karna chahein, toh bas bata dijiyega, main aapke hisaab se timing dekh lungi. Koi jaldi nahi hai.
approver_checklist: Check batch availability if he chooses to wait

manager_note: Highest-ROI message in the batch: a committed buyer lost to an OTP timeout. Day 0 can auto-send because the parent already agreed to the amount and no new offer is made.
